blurb: Bristlecone offers an upscale indoor shooting range with a welcoming atmosphere and emphasis on customer service. Guests can participate in firearms safety and training classes, enjoy women-only events, and compete in monthly shooting matches. The facility includes a retail pro shop and on-site gunsmiths for firearm maintenance and customization.
